hey what is this project about
This is **SHG**, an interactive and automation-focused CLI for **Capacitor Android development**. It helps developers: - Set up Capacitor and Android platforms - Run live-reload development over USB or Wi‑Fi - Build, sync, deploy, and clean Android apps - Manage devices, plugins, logs, assets, and versions - Diagnose Android/Java/SDK issues - Scaffold new apps The repository also includes a **React + Vite documentation website** under `web/`. The CLI is written in **TypeScript**, runs with **Bun or Node.js**, and is invoked as `shg`.
